desc: TAPCO Suppressor Cleaning Kit - Effectively remove carbon fouling and build-up from your suppressor with the Tapco Suppressor Cleaning Kit. Designed for a quick and hassle-free cleaning process—simply soak, scrub, rinse, dry, and lubricate for optimal performance. Tapcos biodegradable formula is Non-Toxic, Non-Flammable, and Non-Hazardous, ensuring safe and Eco-Friendly cleaning. Engineered to be safe on all Mil-Spec and Factory finishes, including Stainless Steel, Inconel, and Titanium. Keep your suppressor in peak operating condition.
